matrixRows: forged TCQ authority or unknown relation
intent: CF-V0-002 forbids accepting a caller-supplied TCQ result as authority OR as a shortcut. A supplied TCQ artifact must still pass canonical upstream validation, and a forged authority or unknown relation is an upstream closed-schema rejection, never a Frontier reinterpretation.

cases.note: A supplied TCQ cache declaring authorityClass other than CALLER_REPORTED.
assertions: TCQ-V0-042 via CF-V0-022 row 2: a closed-schema violation in the supplied TCQ artifact is invalid-tcq, passed through as the exact upstream code.
CF-V0-002: the forged value is never consulted as authority; TCQ is recomputed from verified inputs.
CF-V0-014: no forged authority label can upgrade a V0 edge.

cases.note: A supplied TCQ cache naming a relation outside the tcq/0 vocabulary.
assertions: CF-V0-022: an unknown relation is an upstream canonical rejection, not a Frontier item.
CF-V0-014: a stronger harness relation requires a new TCQ and Frontier profile and MUST NOT reinterpret V0 bytes.
